summary: Older RT22s read; newer units ACK PROGRGS and return an 8-byte ID that matches none of RT22Radio._fileid (P32073, P3\0\0\03, P3207!, 00..F8FF). Trace hid the bytes. Same pattern as upstream CHIRP #6747 (open since 2019). Do not accept an unknown ID blindly: newer units may differ internally. Need the ID bytes and an OEM-software file from a newer unit.
title: Newer (2025+) RT22 units fail identification
